meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (DGCI&S data)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional, revised and final versions are published; we keep the most final version of each period and name it in meta.revision.
meta.coverage: The older direction-of-trade table: exports to and imports from partners and groups, with commodities by partner, 1987-88 to 2013-14, US$ million
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 676, data provider DP0 (the grouping used until 2013-14). Where a year carries both a forecast and a provisional value, the provisional one is kept. A different ruler from trade-dbie-direction (2009-10 on); never joined. Groups overlap; never add them.
